_**Agent (default)**_

No — [`docs/agents/`](docs/agents/) is the human/docs copy, not harness config. Cursor and Claude already have their own dotted trees.

**What actually loads**

| Tree | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [`.cursor/agents/`](.cursor/agents/) | Cursor subagents (Scully, Ruppelt, etc. — generated from the v2 pack) |
| [`.claude/agents/`](.claude/agents/) | Claude Code subagents (app/workspace specialists) |
| [`.agents/skills/`](.agents/skills/) | Cross-harness skills (`/goal`, `/loop`, …) |
| [`docs/agents/ops/`](docs/agents/ops/) | Ops prose: DoD, onboarding, contrib — bound because [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) / [`CLAUDE.md`](CLAUDE.md) point at it |
| [`docs/agents/ultraterrestrial-agent-definitions-v2/`](docs/agents/ultraterrestrial-agent-definitions-v2/) | Source personas; not loaded by any IDE |

Dropping [`DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md`](docs/agents/ops/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md) into `.cursor` or `.claude` would hide it from the docs spine and still would not make it bind unless the root instruction files reference it. Same for stuffing it in [`.agents/`](.agents/) — that folder is skills, not policy.

The ops README already says this split: IDE subagents live in `.cursor/agents/` and `.claude/agents/`; research personas belong in [`packages/ai/agents/`](packages/ai/agents/). The leftover v2 pack under `docs/agents/` is the bulky source, not missing config.

If you want a cleanup: keep ops in `docs/agents/ops/` (or fold DoD into [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)), and treat the v2 directory as archive/source for the generator — do not copy it into every dotted folder.

---
